goalZh: 会值机、回答托运问题,听懂安检指令和 can / can't 说的规定
canDoZh: 能在机场办值机,听懂安检人员的指令,知道哪些东西不能带

newItems.noteZh: 重音在后 ma-CHINE,ch 读 /ʃ/,i 读 /iː/;机场的自助值机机器也叫 kiosk。
在机场是“值机”,在酒店是“办理入住”;连读成 “che-kin”。
No, just a carry-on.(不用,就一个登机箱。)u 读 /ʌ/,结尾 st 不加元音。
Laptops in a bin, please.(电脑放进筐里。)i 读短音 /ɪ/。
Remove your shoes.(把鞋脱了。)是比较正式的说法,机场、告示常用;重音在后 re-MOVE,词尾 v 要带声。
at security(在安检处);重音在 -CU-,美式 t 读闪音。
美式说 trash,英式说 rubbish;the trash 也常指垃圾桶;a 读 /æ/,结尾 sh 是 /ʃ/。
美国公共场所的洗手间常叫 restroom,家里说 bathroom;toilet 在美国多指马桶本身,问洗手间时说 restroom 更自然。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Excuse me. How do I check in on this machine?
lines.zh: (机场的自助值机机器前,磊卡住了)打扰一下,这台机器怎么值机?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sure. Are you checking any bags?
lines.zh: (航空公司的工作人员过来帮忙)好的。您要托运行李吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: OK. Here's your boarding pass. Have a good flight!
lines.zh: 好了。这是您的登机牌。旅途愉快!

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Laptops in a bin, please. And remove your shoes and jacket.
lines.zh: (安检口)电脑放进筐里。鞋和外套也脱下来。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Is that water in your bag?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sorry, you can't have water after security.
lines.zh: 抱歉,过了安检不能带水。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: You can drink it here, or the trash is over there.
lines.zh: 您可以在这儿喝掉,不然垃圾桶在那边。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.zh: (索菲亚在旁边笑)磊!你全喝光了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Yes... and now I need a restroom!
lines.zh: 是啊……现在我得找洗手间了!

questions.prompt: 工作人员问要不要托运,磊怎么说的?
options: 不托运,只有一个登机箱
questions.explainZh: Are you checking any bags? —— No, just a carry-on.

questions.prompt: 安检时,磊的包有什么问题?
questions.explainZh: Is that water in your bag? …… Sorry, you can't have water after security.

questions.prompt: 磊最后怎么处理那瓶水?
questions.explainZh: I'm going to drink it! —— Lei! You drank it all!

grammar.titleZh: can / can't 表示规定:You can't have water.
grammar.bodyZh: 第 7 单元学过 can / can't 表示“会不会”(I can't swim.)。can / can't 还常表示规定上“可以 / 不可以”:You can't have water after security.(过了安检不能带水。)You can drink it here.(你可以在这儿喝掉。)机场、车站的工作人员常用简短的指令:Laptops in a bin, please. / Remove your shoes.。值机说 check in,托运行李说 check a bag:Are you checking any bags? — No, just a carry-on.。发音:airport、boarding 里元音后的 r 美式要卷舌。

examples.text: Sorry, you can't have water after security.
examples.zh: 抱歉,过了安检不能带水。

examples.text: Are you checking any bags? — No, just a carry-on.
examples.zh: 要托运行李吗?——不用,就一个登机箱。
